G1_unambiguity.justification: The linear-span condition, target set, generator costs, and required output are all stated with a single clear interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: It supplies the necessary bounds, input format, structural guarantee, edge cases, output definition, and examples.

G3_faithfulness.justification: With exactly n−1 generators spanning all pairwise differences, the generators form a tree, and selecting generators spanning every target difference is exactly equivalent to selecting the unique tree paths connecting all required sites.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, though the abstract linear-algebra framing and phrases such as “minimal sequence of generators” are somewhat more contrived than standard problem wording.
